verdict.rationale: Docusign's MCP connector lets agents (e.g., Claude) retrieve agreement context and trigger IAM workflow actions, and CLM/AI-Assisted Review can flag non-compliant clauses and draft language, which are building blocks an agent could use in a compliance-related agreement workflow. However, there is no evidence of Docusign supporting end-to-end preparation of an annual report or compliance filing with minimal human input — it only offers agreement/e-signature automation pieces, not full filing-preparation orchestration. Missing for 10: evidence of an agent autonomously assembling/filing a full compliance report or annual filing, evidence of minimal-human-input approval flow, and independent confirmation the MCP/agent pipeline works end-to-end for this use case.
